summary.text: Lucille Puckett is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 91, running against incumbent Republican Kyle Hall in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a community advocate who founded a nonprofit and has served on the board of the Charlotte Housing Authority.

paragraphs.text: Lucille Puckett was born in Detroit, Michigan, and lives in Charlotte, North Carolina.
She earned an associate degree from Floyd College, a bachelor's degree from South Carolina State University, and a master's degree from the University of Phoenix.
Puckett has served as a community advocate for the National Action Network, as a member of ACORN, and as the director of Project Pacts Today.

In her Ballotpedia survey, she said she is the founder of Take Back Our H.O.O.D.S., an organization that supports families and communities affected by violence, and a former NAACP Mecklenburg County Vice Chair.
She listed public safety and gun violence prevention among her priorities, along with public schools, affordable health care and housing, good-paying jobs and responsible growth.
